# argv the pane ran, binary first. The flags parse; the profile then refuses to

# mode with the very sentence the headless child exits on — so NO composer was
# reached, NO composer capture is recorded here, and grok's readiness marker is
# therefore provisional rather than pinned: everything after
# `provisional marker (...): ` is the welcome-banner string the vendor's own

# parenthesis names rather than observed here, and the test beside
# `READY_MARKER` byte-compares the constant against that line. The same test
# asserts this recording holds neither a `composer capture` line (codex's
# recording's spelling) nor a `footer marker:` line (agy's), so the day a probe
# on a working grok home reaches the composer, whoever records it must add
# exactly one line here —

# — and that test then fails until the marker is turned into a byte comparison
